content: Hantavirus Outbreak Toolkit For Everyone May 8, 2026 Purpose This toolkit provides resources and tools related to the current hantavirus outbreak. Current outbreak CDC is responding to a deadly outbreak of Andes virus, a type of hantavirus, among passengers and crew of a cruise ship in the Atlantic Ocean. Andes Virus Outbreak on a Cruise Ship: Current Situation Current situation on the hantavirus outbreak that was reported May 2, 2026. May 12, 2026 Understanding hantavirus About Hantavirus An overview of hantavirus, how it's spread and how it can be treated. About Andes Virus An overview of Andes virus, signs and symptoms, how it spreads, and treatment. Hantavirus Prevention How to clean up after pet rodents and safely clean up after infestations. Andes Virus Outbreak on a Cruise Ship: Frequently Asked Questions Find answers to questions about the Andes virus outbreak on a cruise ship in the Atlantic Ocean. Health department resources Hantavirus disease is a nationally notifiable condition. Clinical resources Clinical Overview of Hantavirus Hantavirus infection causes potentially serious diseases. Hantavirus is spread by rodents. Clinician Brief: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) Clinical information about HPS, a severe disease that affects the lungs.
